Jharkhand Foundation Day: Pradeep Yadav ko kaee phaisle nahin le pane ka kyon aaj bhi malal sunie?
Jharkhand sthapna divas ke mauke par rajy ke 26 sal ke saphar, vikas aur rajnitik phaislon par khas batchita. purv mantri pradip yadav ne un phaislon ka jikr kiya, jinhen vah apne karyakal men nahin le pae aur jinka malal unhen aaj bhi hai. aakhir kin paristhitiyon men ye phaisle nahin ho sake? jharkhand ke vikas ko lekar unki kya ray hai?
